name: fixed-feb-30-next
description: Fixed-date year starting on day 30 of month 2 with short_month 'next': a missing day becomes the first day of the following month. Covers leap and non-leap years (2024, 2100) and periods that start in short months. Weeks use contains_start: week 1 runs from the year's first day to the day before the next week start (7 days when the year starts on the week-start weekday), and day_of_week counts from the weekday, so a partial week can begin on a day_of_week other than 1.

source.citation: Independent implementation of the spec in conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py, written with Python datetime and no fiscalclock code
